subject: MARATHON: command-mastery waves 2-5 (17 labs) — build + live-test each
description: After Lost Notes passes live testing, stamp the template across: Wave 2 files/navigation (ls, pwd/cd, cp/mv, rm, mkdir/rmdir); Wave 3 text (less/more, head/tail, grep, sort/uniq, wc); Wave 4 attributes/archive (find, chmod, chown, tar/gzip); Wave 5 ops (ps/top/kill, systemctl [image has shim], ip/ss/ping). Each lab: mission story reusing the same fictional company (seeded continuity), 10-20 server-checked tasks, badge, randomization, live end-to-end test on bc1 (launch, seed, solve, grade, badge, destroy), Nancy+Chris per wave. Frontend: mission picker on the Observatory sandbox card. Docs per wave; Confluence at the end. Do not stop between waves.
